task: explore: new research-algorithm tool, Kalman smoother for structural time-series models
errors: First SOURCE.md draft carried a placeholder SHA-256 line; caught and replaced with the computed hashes before commit.
First fit of the UK series (auto trend, 13 states) took 26 s; fixed with a likelihood-only sparse filter with steady-state shortcut (2.5 s).
Loosening the Nelder-Mead stopping rule moved the Nile variance to 15,098.6; a page test pinned to 15,098.5 caught it; added a tight final polish.
integrity_issues: The Durbin & Koopman Nile figures (15,099 and 1,469.1) are quoted as widely cited; the book was not re-read in this session. README says so.

doc_friction.issue: No pointer to portfolio/research-tools/README.md, though most recent explore runs build there; found it only by grepping run records.

notes: Explore idea: a Kalman smoother / structural time-series tool (ventures/kalman-smoother), since the repository had no state-space model. Exact diffuse filter and smoother (Durbin & Koopman 2012; Koopman 1997), MLE with concentrated scale, AIC with diffuse elements to choose drift/trend, dummy seasonal, missing values, forecasts, auxiliary residuals for outliers and level shifts. Verified against statsmodels 0.15.0 exact-diffuse UnobservedComponents on 5 cases at equal variances: max relative difference 1.1e-11 (eval/agreement.mjs); own MLE >= statsmodels' in all 5. Finds Nile 1898-99 and UK Jan-Feb 1983 seat-belt law unprompted. statsmodels' default exact-diffuse fit of the Nile stops short (15,067.6/1,484.8, loglik 8e-5 below optimum). No agent doc in docs/reports: the README and research-tools candidates list carry what the next run needs.
